title: Sluice recipe
description:
A Sluice recipe: proposed reductions for one kind of log event. Proposals are never trusted: the guardrails
narrow them to what the loaded rules allow, and the shadow proof rolls back anything that
changes an alert. See `recipes/README.md`.

description.description: One line on what the recipe targets.

id.description: Unique id, mirroring the file path: `<vendor>/<product>/<event>`.

match.description: Which templates the recipe applies to.

rationale.description:
Why the reductions are safe and worthwhile, stating only facts that hold for every
deployment of the source.

reductions.description:
The proposed reductions. Without `discriminators` or `pattern`, only lossless ones
(`drop_fields`, `drop_empty_fields`) are allowed.

FieldPath.description:
A dotted path to a field in an event, such as `TargetUserName` or `process.parent.name`.

Sigma and Wazuh rules refer to fields by these names, so the same type is used for the fields a
rule needs and the fields a reduction touches. Comparisons are exact and case-sensitive.
Event schemas are case-sensitive, and treating `user` and `User` as equal would hide a
guardrail miss.

LogSource.description:
Sigma-style log source descriptor (`product`, `service`, `category`).

Rules use it to say which data they apply to, and templates use it to say what they are. A
missing attribute means "unknown" on a template and "any" on a rule.

Matcher.description: Which templates a recipe applies to. Every given condition must hold.

discriminators.description: JSON templates: discriminator values, such as `EventID: "4624"`.

logsource.description: The Sigma-style log source; every attribute given must equal the template's.

pattern.description: Text templates: a substring of the template pattern.

oneOf.description: L1: drop fields that duplicate other fields or carry boilerplate.
L1: drop fields whose value is `null` or an empty string.
L2: forward events a rule could match. The rest go to summaries keyed by `summary_keys`.

summary_keys.description: Fields that key the summaries of events that are not forwarded.

oneOf.description: L3: send only summaries keyed by `summary_keys`. Full events stay in the archive.
